name: litellm-lens
description: Send Claude Code sessions to LiteLLM Lens: prompts, replies, model calls and tools.

lens_url.title: LiteLLM gateway URL
lens_url.description: Base URL of the LiteLLM gateway, for example https://gateway.example.com. A standalone Lens URL works as well

lens_key.title: LiteLLM key
lens_key.description: LiteLLM key sent with each trace, so the gateway records its user and team. For a standalone Lens, a Lens tracing key
